profiles.name: Bariaur
speciesTraits: Medium Outsider native to Ysgard. It gains the Extraplanar subtype away from Ysgard. Racial adjustments are +2 Strength and −2 Charisma. Land speed 40 ft. and darkvision 60 ft.
Quadruped. +4 on checks to resist bull rush and trip, and 1½ times the normal carrying capacity for the Bariaur’s Strength. Bariaurs wear barding and cannot wear humanoid boots.

Powerful Charge. On a charge a Bariaur can make a single ram attack for 2d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1½ times its Strength modifier. Apply the normal charge rules. The trait only grants the ram during a charge.
Spell resistance equals 11 + class level. Bariaurs have a +2 racial bonus on Will saves against spells and spell-like abilities and a +2 racial bonus on Listen and Spot checks.
Celestial and Common are automatic. Abyssal and Infernal are bonus languages. Favored class Ranger. LA +1. The playable profile specifies no racial Hit Dice.
Page 8 identifies the larger Bariaurs in Book of Exalted Deeds as Exalted Bariaurs.

npcBuilds.name: Mara Sedgehill

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
build.title: Bariaur switchback scout, Ranger 1
traits: Chaotic good. Material Plane. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +1 (+3 against spells and spell-like abilities that require a Will save).
Studded leather barding supplies +3 armor and an armor check penalty of −1. As Medium nonhumanoid armor it costs 50 gp and weighs 20 lb. It leaves land speed at 40 ft. with a light load.

Spell resistance 12 (11 + one class level). Against an applicable spell or spell-like ability, the caster must roll 12 or higher on 1d20 + caster level. Lowering spell resistance is a standard action.
Quadruped. Strength-based checks to resist bull rush or trip are +7. Light load up to 114 lb. with Strength 16.

Track is a Ranger bonus feat. Wild empathy +0. Point Blank Shot adds +1 to ranged attack and damage rolls within 30 ft. Favored enemy undead adds +2 to the listed Listen, Spot, and Survival checks against undead and +2 to weapon damage against them. It also applies to Bluff and Sense Motive against undead.
actions: Longsword +4 melee, 1d8+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Longbow +3 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 100 ft. Within 30 ft. longbow +4 for 1d8+1.

Powerful Charge. When a charge is legal, make one ram attack at +6 for 2d6+4 bludgeoning. Move at least 10 ft. along a clear path and up to 80 ft. on a normal full-round charge. AC drops to 13 until the start of her next turn.
build.tactics: Mara scouts the switchback for a messenger who never reached the ford. She uses the bow when the path bends. On the straight stretch she can charge a foe blocking the crossing.

npcBuilds.motive: Find the messenger before the ford becomes impassable.
npcBuilds.hook: Mara traced the rider as far as the bend above the ford.

npcBuilds.name: Kel Stoneford

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
build.title: Bariaur stoneford guard, Fighter 1
traits: Neutral good. Material Plane. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fortitude +4, Reflex +1, Will +3 (+5 against spells and spell-like abilities that require a Will save). Iron Will adds +2 to Will saves.
Studded leather barding supplies +3 armor and an armor check penalty of −1. As Medium nonhumanoid armor it costs 50 gp and weighs 20 lb. It leaves land speed at 40 ft. with a light load.

Spell resistance 12 (11 + one class level). Against an applicable spell or spell-like ability, the caster must roll 12 or higher on 1d20 + caster level. Lowering spell resistance is a standard action.
Quadruped. Strength-based checks to resist bull rush or trip are +8. Light load up to 150 lb. with Strength 18. Weapon Focus (greatsword) is the Fighter bonus feat.
actions: Greatsword +6 melee, 2d6+6 slashing, critical 19–20/×2. A greatsword charge is +8 for the same damage.
Powerful Charge. When a charge is legal, make one ram attack at +7 for 2d6+6 bludgeoning. With either charge, AC drops to 12 until the start of his next turn.
build.tactics: Kel holds the stone ford while livestock cross. A hostile spellcaster can test his spell resistance or target the crossing instead. Kel can voluntarily lower his resistance so an allied spell gets through if he has time to plan for it.

npcBuilds.motive: Get the flock and its handlers over the ford before reopening the road.
npcBuilds.hook: Kel needs someone to guide the last animals while he guards the crossing.
